review:
Wild Moon Thieves is a 5x4, 25-line slot set on a mysterious moon. Moon spiders cause mischief in the base game by replacing random symbols with wilds, which keeps ordinary spins lively.

Two bonus symbols trigger Moon Respin, a Hold and Win-style round where moons with random multipliers up to 20x are held in place. Three special symbols join the feature: a Collector that takes the values of all moons on screen, a Booster that increases the multipliers of all moons, and a Cleaner. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the 97% RTP is excellent. Free spins are very rare (about once every 600 spins), so the respin feature is the main event.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 600 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
